categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in research, development, production and sales of integrated circuit specialized equipment, specifically focusing on integrated circuit testing equipment. Main product lines include test systems (such as D9000 SOC test machines, analog-mixed test machines, aging test machines, and high-power test machines), automatic sorting systems (including gravity-type, flat-moving, and turret-type sorters), and AOI optical inspection equipment. The company also provides automation equipment for fingerprint modules and camera modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core technologies in integrated circuit testing equipment through years of continuous R&D investment. Key technologies include high-precision optical detection (2D/3D AOI technology), automatic control systems, and software development. The company employs a combination of self-developed design and manufacturing, with some outsourced processing for PCB welding, cable welding, and mechanical parts surface treatment. Production follows a make-to-order and inventory-based production model based on annual sales plans.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include integrated circuit packaging and testing enterprises, wafer manufacturing enterprises, and chip design enterprises. Major customers include industry leaders such as Changdian Technology, Huatian Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics, Shilan Micro, Huarun Microelectronics, and Ritek. The company's products serve both domestic and international markets, with significant presence in China's long triangle region where major IC enterprises are concentrated.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has established regional marketing service points in Shanghai, Nantong, and Tianshui. Subsidiary STI operates in Singapore, South Korea, and the Philippines with service teams. The company also has operations in Japan through Changchuan Japan Co., Ltd., and in Malaysia through EXIS company. International operations represent approximately 18.30% of 2023 revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the semiconductor equipment supply chain. It manufactures specialized testing and sorting equipment used in the semiconductor packaging and testing phase, which occurs after wafer manufacturing but is critical for quality assurance before final product delivery. The company sources components from suppliers and sells directly to semiconductor manufacturers and packaging/testing enterprises.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company pursues a three-dimensional development strategy: product depth (enhancing existing core technologies), product line breadth (developing new product lines including probe stations and digital test machines), and market expansion (moving from mid-to-low-end to mid-to-high-end markets, and from domestic to international markets). R&D investment in 2023 reached 787.79 million yuan (44.38% of revenue), focusing on high-end testing equipment and import substitution.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of specialized semiconductor testing and sorting equipment. Revenue recognition occurs when products are installed, debugged, and accepted by customers, or when equipment passes trial operation and receives customer acceptance reports. The company also generates minor revenue from other business activities including equipment rental, waste material sales, and material sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major global competitors include Teradyne (USA), Advantest (Japan), Agilent (USA), and Cohu (USA), which collectively hold over 66% of the global test equipment market. Domestically, the company is among the few enterprises capable of independent R&D and production of IC testing equipment. The company has achieved import substitution in logic circuit testing, analog-mixed circuit testing, and power device testing, with competitive advantages in product performance-to-price ratio and localized service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of 1,775.05 million yuan (down 31.11% YoY) and net profit of 45.16 million yuan (down 90.21% YoY), reflecting industry cyclical downturn and increased R&D investment. Total assets reached 5,901.58 million yuan (up 25.80% YoY), with equity of 2,878.61 million yuan (up 26.42% YoY). The company has experienced significant growth historically but faced headwinds in 2023 due to macroeconomic conditions and industry cycles.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) strong R&D capability with 843 authorized patents and 63 software copyrights; (2) superior cost-performance ratio compared to international competitors; (3) customized product solutions meeting specific customer requirements; (4) responsive local service and technical support; (5) continuous innovation in high-end equipment to achieve import substitution; and (6) comprehensive product portfolio covering test machines, sorting machines, and optical inspection equipment.
